A '''skirmish''' was fought between [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Duchess Satine's]] [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorians]], and [[Moogan/Legends|Moogan]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] harboring illegal [[Tea/Legends|tea]]. The firefight broke out in the tea storage facility and one Moogan was killed and a captain wounded. Soon after, the wounded New Mandalorian Police Captain ordered his men to burn down the warehouse and all of the tea with it. The leader of the Moogan smugglers was arrested and placed into [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police]] custody.
